items.title: Bob Wilber Interview, 1961-05-01
items.q: we used to play along with records, you know, Bob Crosby and Benny Goodman

ctx.x: And what kind of instrument was it? You know, metal ones or something like that, was it really?

Yeah, I had a Penzlmuller gold clarinet with silver keys and I thought that was much better, much flashier than the wooden ones, you know. Yeah. But I started to try to play jazz even, well maybe two or three years before that with, I had a buddy who was a drummer and I played a little tin flute and we used to play along with records, you know, Bob Crosby and Benny Goodman. A lot of the guys that did down here started on that.
Yeah. Yeah. At that time, who were your favorite musicians? Is that when you actually began playing?
